mines.mine_notes: Open pit + underground; 19.2 Mt milled; recoveries 88.0% Au / 81.1% Cu. Sold 326,859 oz gold and 14,730 t copper at average realized price A$6,223/oz Au and A$14,895/t Cu. Costs reported in AUD: AISC A$2,179/oz gold produced (net of copper by-product credits; excludes inventory movements). 100% acquired December 2024. FY27 guidance: 260,000-300,000 oz gold at AISC A$2,900-3,330/oz.

Development stage. Final investment decision June 2026 following December 2025 Feasibility Study: post-tax NPV approximately US$2.9B at base-case gold pricing; steady-state production ~265,000 oz gold per annum; first production targeted FY29. Ore to be processed through Telfer infrastructure. Growth capex FY27 guidance A$365-435M.
mines.processing: To be processed through Telfer concentrator
